title: StartRun does not reset bDragging/DragStartScreen despite claiming 'no state leakage'
detail: A drag held across StartRun survives into the fresh arena: EndDraw then snaps the stale DragStartScreen and applies a pipe against the new topology — the exact leakage the comment denies.
recommended_fix: Reset bDragging = false (and DragStartScreen) at the top of StartRun().

title: EndDraw computes EndGrid and never uses it
detail: EndGrid is computed then abandoned — the snap runs in screen space. Dead store left in the diff; readers assume grid math still participates in the draw path.
recommended_fix: Delete the EndGrid line (and the ScreenToGrid call) or use it in the intent.

title: PacketGridPos uses ZeroVector as the absent-packet sentinel — collides with a real (0,0) position
detail: A packet genuinely at grid (0,0) is indistinguishable from an absent one: bInPrev reads false and the dot snaps instead of easing. Latent for any future node at the origin.
recommended_fix: Return a found-flag (out param / TOptional) instead of overloading ZeroVector.

title: MakeRoad has no zero-length guard for co-located endpoints
detail: The sim accepts a pipe between two distinct nodes at the same position (span 0 <= any max_span), giving Length 0: a zero-size box with an Atan2(0,0) angle renders nothing, no guard or diagnostic.
recommended_fix: Skip or early-return in MakeRoad when Length <= 0 (or reject span==0 draws in ValidateDraw).
